subject: Preserve the phalanx visibility query before dead/unconscious rejection
description: The completed-sweep visibility_queries.length representative, schema-14 Cyrdach Profile_156 Savegame_001 replay-011, historically first diverged after frame 1121 with Original=5 and Rust=4. The frozen e806655f8 runner reproduces that frontier: Original's fifth query duplicates the fourth query from [758.6776733398438, 2687.139404296875, 45.0] to PC 252 at [744.8360595703125, 2477.652587890625, 45.0], while frozen Rust stops after four detection.rs queries. The current runner records the same fifth query, result=false, from ai_enemy/combat_positions.rs:176 and matches all five Original queries. Original RHArtificialMalignity::PhalanxReinitializeThemList in original-code/RHartificialmalignity.cpp likewise calls mpMe->IsDetecting180Degrees(pEnemy) before testing !pEnemy->IsDead() && !pEnemy->IsUnconscious(). Task 147 is therefore completed/superseded by daeacac810 with no standalone production change or rebuild required.
